parsed.restated: ∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 32 ≤ n) (f : RationalFormula (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ), RationalFormula.Valid f → RationalFormula.eval f = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ) (FractionRing (MvPolynomial (Fin n × Fin n) ℂ)) (permanentPolynomial n) → (n : ℝ) ^ 4 ≤ (RationalFormula.variableLeaves f : ℝ) * (192 * Real.logb 2 (n : ℝ))
parsed.proof:
constructor
· intro h n hn f hv hf
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega)
  have hpos : 0 < 192 * Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) h1)
  have := h hn f hv hf
  rwa [div_le_iff₀ hpos] at this
· intro h n hn f hv hf
  have h1 : (1:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 < n by omega)
  have hpos : 0 < 192 * Real.logb 2 (n:ℝ) := mul_pos (by norm_num) (Real.logb_pos (by norm_num) h1)
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hpos]
  exact h hn f hv hf
parsed.english: For n ≥ 32, any valid rational formula (division only by nonzero subformulas) over ℂ that computes the n×n permanent polynomial in the fraction field has a number of variable leaves L satisfying n^4 ≤ L · 192 · log₂ n.
parsed.why_clearer: It removes the division by the logarithm, which is safe because log₂ n > 0 for n ≥ 32, so the bound reads as a plain product inequality n^4 ≤ 192·L·log₂ n.
